Name: Cuter Vanilla Seasons Recolor
Author: marchnshirley
Description:
Notes:
1. Not compatible with Meadowlands farm. Some square patches show up. I'll update the mod when I'm able to fix it.
2. The artifact spots or small black squiggles are almost invisible in the deep brown dirt. I use the SEASONAL CLOVER 
DIG SPOT to detect the artifact spots again.
2. This mod matches the Vanilla ELLE'S TOWN BUILDINGS and SIMPLE FOLIAGE mods the most.
3. If you want matching fertilizer, worms, and visual glitch fixes, feel free to make an unofficial continuation of this mod.

Terrain changes:
1. Made spring/winter more cool-toned and summer/fall more warm-toned. Unique seasons with distinct color schemes.
2. Added darker and more realistic dirt to make the game more easy on the eyes. Banished the neon yellow
terrain to the arid desert.
3. Ginger Island matches the changes made to summer terrain. I also added matching hoed dirt colors.

Manifest.Name: Cuter Vanilla Seasons Recolor
Manifest.Description: More distinct seasonal color schemes. Slightly toned down terrain. Darker dirt.
Manifest.Author: vanillapurist
